scenarios.label: E1 — 8-storey comparator, approved footprints at RL 48.0 (default)
scenarios.note: The approved Building A footprint and Building B plate cut at RL 48.0: the comparator of the sealed v1.1-AB incremental tables. It matches the applicant's own 'equivalent 8 storey approved built form' line on DA-600/601 Rev 8 (best-fitting height RL 48.0; verify/out/ellivo_registration.json). Same footprints as the approved towers, so any difference from E2/E2c is height alone. The 2020 approval fixed eight storeys, not an RL: RL 47.0 and 49.0 bracket the fit.

scenarios.label: E1 sensitivity — approved footprints at RL 47.0
scenarios.note: Lower bound of the RL 48 ± 1 m fit; plan geometry identical to E1_CUT48.

scenarios.label: E1 sensitivity — approved footprints at RL 49.0
scenarios.note: Upper bound of the RL 48 ± 1 m fit; plan geometry identical to E1_CUT48.

scenarios.label: E1 — 2020 reconstruction, SK48
scenarios.note: Received (not approved) 2020 envelope plan SK00.03 A, extruded to RL 48.0. No RL was ever fixed; not an exact approved 2020 envelope. Its footprints differ from the approved towers, so E1_SK48 vs E2 mixes footprint position with height; E1_CUT48 isolates height.

scenarios.label: E1 sensitivity — SK52
scenarios.note: Same SK family at RL 52.0 (roof-plant allowance).

scenarios.label: E1 hypothetical — SK48 + approved podium
scenarios.note: Bounds the unknown 2020 podium by adding the approved podium to SK48. Hypothetical.

scenarios.label: E2 — approved 2026 form, VA2 plates only
scenarios.note: Approved-plan plates; balcony volumes filled to the plate line; balustrades not modelled separately. Known under-representation: over part of the Building B west face the plate lies up to 2.88 m inside the approved balcony line, and the podiums outside the tower plates are absent (VA4 Part D). Kept for continuity with VA2; E2c is the default.

scenarios.label: E2c — approved 2026 form, VA4-corrected (default)
scenarios.note: E2 plates plus the corrections VA4 Part D found necessary: the Building B west balcony line (DA-106 dimensions 3000 / 4100 and Council's "3 m to balcony, 4.1 m to wall"; outline traced from DA-107 Rev 15, ±0.15 m) and the A/B west and B south podiums (DA-103 / DA-402 content, ±0.15 m). Scaled from the approved drawings, not dimensioned at every vertex. It includes the approved podiums; the 2020 podium is unknown, so compare with E1_SK48_POD for a like-for-like podium.
